metricPolicy: source-record-weighted; group projections never counted as physical classes; room/calendar blocked counts overlap; immediate highlighting zero until policy/calendar gates

sourceLessonRecords.evidenceBasis: complete unfiltered live GET /api/schedule per selected course; one source record counted once

groupProjections.evidenceBasis: sum distinct groups memberships per source record; these are memberships, not physical classes

uniqueRawRoomStrings.evidenceBasis: distinct exact raw room strings; null retained separately in inventory

uniqueCanonicalB3RoomCodes.evidenceBasis: actual current FIX-01 parser AND explicit Building 3 identity; bare parser output not authoritative

uniqueParserAcceptedRoomStrings.evidenceBasis: actual current FIX-01 parser alone; includes bare hypothetical B3 and basement outputs; no building authority

candidateCatalogIdentity.evidenceBasis: bare single code numerically matches confirmed catalog but upstream building authority missing; resolver still returns unknown-building

uniqueCandidateCatalogRooms.evidenceBasis: single bare numeric strings matching catalog; no verified location association

ambiguousRoom.evidenceBasis: slash/comma expressions or numeric/D range-like hyphen expressions; ambiguity marker, not proof of multiple physical rooms

missingOrAmbiguousRoom.evidenceBasis: union of missing and slash/comma/range-like ambiguous fields

building3Explicit.evidenceBasis: explicit leading 3- with no conflicting explicit building prefix; includes unsupported auditorium/composite notation; building signal only

confirmedMapIdentity.evidenceBasis: current ROOM-01B catalog; user-confirmed, on-site unknown; synthetic bindings excluded; empty manual bindings for isolated audit

confirmedIdentityAmongBuilding3.evidenceBasis: conditional lesson-weighted coverage among records with explicit Building 3 indication

uniqueRoomCoverage.evidenceBasis: exact raw strings excluding null/blank; confirmed user catalog identity

uniqueB3RoomCoverage.evidenceBasis: explicit Building 3 signals including unsupported notations; not whole-building coverage

eligibleForImmediateFutureHighlighting.evidenceBasis: no authoritative date-validity calendar; user-confirmed policy not yet accepted for real highlighting; requires D5/D6/D7

blockedByRoomIdentity.evidenceBasis: no eligible user-confirmed catalog mapping; includes missing/other-building/unsupported/unmapped; overlapping with calendar blocking

blockedByUncertainCalendarSemantics.evidenceBasis: weekly patterns only: API exposes no authoritative teaching-date interval/exceptions; overlapping with room blocking

unknownWeekParity.evidenceBasis: exact live week_parity; no coercion to both

uncertainParser.evidenceBasis: exact live uncertain flag; not independent room verification

multiGroupSourceRecords.evidenceBasis: source record with more than one distinct group

multiSlotSourceRecords.evidenceBasis: slot_span > 1; start_time/end_time already span the cells

duplicateSourceIds.evidenceBasis: course-scoped IDs within these snapshots only
